title: collection_policy
text: Customer communications must be respectful, accurate, and consistent with approved lender policy.

title: collection_policy
text: Agents must use the approved authentication process before disclosing account-specific information.

title: collection_policy
text: Agents may discuss repayment arrangements only within their approved authority.

title: collection_policy
text: A promise-to-pay should record the promised amount and date in the approved collection system.

title: collection_policy
text: If a customer indicates financial hardship, follow the approved hardship-assessment process.

title: collection_policy
text: Exceptions outside agent authority must be escalated to an authorized human reviewer.

title: communication_guidelines
text: Do not shame, threaten, abuse, deceive, or mislead the customer.

title: communication_guidelines
text: Do not claim legal action, penalties, credit reporting consequences, discounts, waivers, or settlement approval unless explicitly supported by approved policy.

title: communication_guidelines
text: The AI must not invent a repayment plan or legal consequence.

title: communication_guidelines
text: When policy is missing or ambiguous, refer the matter to an authorized human reviewer.

title: ptp_policy
text: A promise-to-pay should capture the promised amount and promised date.

title: ptp_policy
text: Previous PTP behavior can be used as a risk signal, but an ML score alone must not determine whether a customer receives or is denied an option.

title: ptp_policy
text: If a customer cannot meet a previous promise, reassess the situation under approved policy.

title: ptp_policy
text: PTP exceptions should be reviewed by an authorized collection supervisor.
